questions.question: Describe a person you know who enjoys helping other people.
questions.question_vi: Hãy miêu tả một người bạn biết thích giúp đỡ người khác.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
Today, I’m going to talk about a person I greatly admire, who is a well-known entrepreneur and a dedicated environmentalist in my country. I first came across his story on a social media video titled “Inside the Mind of a Master,” and I was immediately blown away by his perseverance.

He runs a successful business that produces organic fertilizers from recycled waste. What makes him stand out is not just his ability to make a profit, but also his generosity and passion for protecting the environment. Despite his busy schedule, he regularly organizes workshops to encourage people to reduce plastic waste and live a greener lifestyle.

I remember a time when his company faced a predicament due to a lack of funding. It was a difficult decision, but he decided to sell his own house to keep the project running. This was a heartwarming moment for all his employees and a testament to his commitment.

The reason I’d love to meet him in person is that he embodies the pursuit of excellence and is a true role model for the younger generation. He has managed to climb the corporate ladder while remaining a down-to-earth person who always finds time for disadvantaged people.

Watching his journey has broadened my horizons and motivated me to pursue my own ambitions with more courage.

questions.question: Describe a place you enjoyed visiting that was very quiet.
questions.question_vi: Mô tả một nơi bạn thích đến thăm và rất yên tĩnh.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
If I had to describe a place that left a lasting impression on me, it would definitely be Da Lat, a picturesque city in the Central Highlands of Vietnam. I paid a visit to this city last summer to recharge my batteries after a stressful semester at university.

What I love most about Da Lat is its tranquility. Unlike the hustle and bustle of the city I live in, Da Lat offers a peaceful atmosphere where you can truly feel at ease. The city is famous for its stunning landscapes, with pine forests and colorful flower gardens that are absolutely breathtaking.

I believe it is a good place to live because the weather is mild all year round, and the pollution levels are much lower than in urban centers. During my stay, I spent most of my time wandering around Xuan Huong Lake or sitting in trendy cafés to enjoy the homey vibe.

One of the most memorable occasions was when I visited a faraway village on the outskirts. The locals were incredibly hospitable, and I had the chance to enjoy some local delicacies that were to die for.

This trip really melted my frustration away and helped me clear my mind. I would wholeheartedly recommend this city to anyone looking for a place to escape from reality for a while.

items.title: Experiences Or Events — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a time when you felt very proud of a family member.
questions.question_vi: Hãy mô tả thời điểm bạn cảm thấy rất tự hào về một thành viên trong gia đình.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I’m going to share a story about my brother’s graduation ceremony, which was a truly memorable occasion. This was a time when I saw a lot of people smiling happily, and I felt extremely proud of what my brother had achieved.

To give you some background, my brother had been struggling with his major in higher education and often felt overwhelmed by the exam-driven curriculum. However, through perseverance and hard work, he finally mastered his subjects and graduated with honors.

During the ceremony, there was a small technical glitch—the slide projector for his presentation suddenly broke. Everyone was worried, but my brother found a clever solution by using a cutting-edge app on his tablet to stream the content directly to the hall’s main screen. His quick thinking saved the day, and I was blown away by his problem-solving skills.

Seeing the joy on my parents’ faces and the wide smiles of his friends was a heartwarming moment that I will never forget. It was a milestone in his life that brought our family closer together.

This experience taught me that if we stay down-to-earth and maintain a positive mindset, we can overcome any challenges that come our way.

items.title: Objects Or Technology — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe an object that you think is beautiful.
questions.question_vi: Miêu tả một đồ vật mà bạn cho là đẹp.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
Today, I’d like to talk about my high-end smartphone, which I consider both a useful invention and a beautiful object. To be honest, I am a tech-savvy person, so I’m always blown away by cutting-edge devices.

I received this phone as a gift after I successfully achieved a high score in my final exam. Hearing about my result was a piece of good news that really made my day.

The phone has a sleek design with a picturesque wallpaper of a forest—a photo that makes me feel happy every time I unlock the screen. Beyond its appearance, it is an indispensable tool in my daily life. I use it to access a website I often visit called Coursera, where I can broaden my horizons through online courses.

What I find most fascinating is the artificial intelligence integrated into the camera, which allows me to capture stunning landscapes with just one click.

In this fast-paced world, this device helps me stay well-informed and manage my busy schedule efficiently. Even though some people say we are too dependent on technology, I believe that, if used wisely, it can be a clever solution for simplifying our lives and melting our frustration away after a long day at work.

items.title: Activities Or Public Places — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a park or a garden in your city.
questions.question_vi: Mô tả một công viên hoặc một khu vườn ở thành phố của bạn.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I’m going to describe a new development in my neighborhood, which is a massive eco-friendly park combined with a cultural center. It has recently become a popular destination for both locals and tourists. I first paid a visit there last month and was immediately impressed by its stunning landscapes and modern facilities.

This place is a perfect blend of nature and modern architecture. There is a large botanical garden where you can find various species of plants from different regions, making it an ideal place to learn about different cultures.

Although it is often crowded, especially during weekends, it still maintains a peaceful atmosphere in the early morning.

I usually go there to recharge my batteries after a hectic week. The park features a long walking path, which is great for physical health. What’s more, the local government built this place to encourage people to enjoy outdoor activities and protect the environment.

It’s not just a beautiful public place; it’s also a milestone in our city’s urban planning that has brought the community closer together. I believe every city needs such a tranquil spot to help people escape from reality for a while.

items.title: Plans Or Changes — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe an outdoor activity you did for the first time.
questions.question_vi: Mô tả một hoạt động ngoài trời lần đầu tiên bạn thực hiện.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I’d like to share with you a major change I want to make in my life, which is also a long-term goal I’ve been pursuing. That is to become a freelance digital marketer and work in a foreign country, specifically Japan.

This ambition started when I first tried scuba diving, an outdoor activity I experienced for the first time during a trip to Okinawa. That experience was a turning point for me. I realized that I wanted a career that would allow me to travel around the world and broaden my horizons rather than being stuck in a nine-to-five job.

To achieve this difficult goal, I am currently investing time in learning Japanese and mastering digital marketing skills. It’s a daunting task, but I am determined to climb the career ladder in a global environment.

Working abroad would not only help me earn a higher salary but also give me a chance to immerse myself in a different culture. I know there will be many challenges ahead, but I’m ready to overcome any obstacles to turn this dream into reality.

This change would definitely put my life on a completely new path.

items.title: Books, Films, Or News — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a book you want to read again.
questions.question_vi: Hãy miêu tả một cuốn sách mà bạn muốn đọc lại.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I’m going to tell you about a masterpiece of literature that I’ve read recently, which is also a story that made me feel strongly. I first came across this book through a well-informed friend, and it was actually good news to find a story that could truly broaden my horizons.

The book tells a heartwarming story about perseverance and the pursuit of excellence. What strikes me most is the vivid description of the characters, which makes the plot so fascinating that I can hardly put the book down.

However, I once saw an advertisement for the movie version of this book that I didn’t like at all. It was too commercial and failed to capture the tranquility of the original work.

I want to read this book again because each time I open it, it helps me clear my mind and melt my frustration away after a hectic day. It’s a story that embodies human courage and has given me a new perspective on life.

I believe that sharing such positive stories is an effective way to bring people closer together and encourage a more empathetic society.

items.title: Time Or Memories — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a time you had to wait for something for a long time.
questions.question_vi: Mô tả một lần bạn phải chờ đợi một điều gì đó trong một thời gian dài.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I’d like to talk about a time when I was extremely busy preparing for my final exams, which eventually led to a situation in which I was late for an important meeting. During that period, my daily routine was incredibly hectic, and I was constantly overwhelmed by an exam-driven curriculum.

I remember having to wait for a long time at the bus station because of a massive traffic jam. I felt a huge sense of frustration as the minutes ticked by. I tried to find a clever solution by calling a ride-hailing service, but even that didn’t help much amid the hustle and bustle of the city.

When I finally arrived, I felt embarrassed, but that experience was a turning point for me. It taught me the importance of time management and forced me to restructure my schedule.

Now, I always find time to prepare everything in advance to ensure that I’m always on time. This routine not only improves my productivity but also helps me feel at ease during busy periods.

Trong thời gian đó, công việc hàng ngày của tôi vô cùng bận rộn và tôi liên tục bị choáng ngợp bởi chương trình giảng dạy theo hướng thi cử.

items.title: Plants, Animals, Or Nature — Speaking Part 2 sample

questions.question: Describe a plant that you know about.
questions.question_vi: Hãy tả một loại cây mà em biết.

answers.label: Answer
answers.english:
I want to share an experience from an unusual holiday I had in a remote national park. While I was wandering through the forest, I encountered an interesting animal, which was a rare species of wild cat. It was a memorable occasion because I had only seen such creatures on television before.

During the trip, I also learned about a unique plant that can survive only in that specific ecosystem. It was absolutely breathtaking to see the stunning landscapes of the park.

However, I was deeply saddened when I saw a large amount of plastic waste near a beautiful stream. The sight of all that pollution really shocked me and made me realize how serious the problem had become.

This experience motivated me to encourage people to protect the environment more actively. I believe we should invest more time in cleaning up our public places and promoting a greener lifestyle.

It is our responsibility to ensure that future generations can still enjoy the tranquility and beauty of nature without facing the threat of pollution.
